node.2a6321b4ce90763bf0be564e places component_offered_to_client in Scope. An unoffered component therefore returns OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than FALSE. The other component candidates that place offering or promotional links in Scope similarly require review against the intended distinction between an uncaught component and an excluded assessment.

node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5 and node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 combine an offer-level promotional link with an existential non-discount gift component. They do not expressly require the identified gift component itself to have that link. A mixed offer could therefore produce an unsupported prohibition unless the supplied classifications enforce the connection.

The circular defines distributors by reference to SFC-authorised funds, supporting that contextual actor restriction. Its quotation of paragraph 3.11 refers more broadly to investment products. node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f explicitly restricts the promoted product to SFC-authorised funds; retain the distinction between the selected circular scope and the full Code provision.

A fee discount or non-gift classification establishes only the selected gift-control result. It does not establish compliance with disclosure, advertising, structured-product or other requirements. In particular, TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT in node.6d6e7adc6faa9d94b74c08e5 must retain its expressly limited meaning.
